# AgentReady Local — Full Machine-Readable Knowledge Base & Rubric Specification

MetalMindTech LLC · High-Growth Aesthetic Markets

## 100-Point Scored Audit Rubric Breakdown

1. Identity (15 pts):
   - IDN-01: LocalBusiness schema present with legal name & address
   - IDN-02: Directory NAP consistency across GBP, Yelp, & top directories
   - IDN-03: sameAs entity links to official profiles

2. Services & Pricing (15 pts):
   - SVC-01: Service schema for each aesthetic treatment offered
   - SVC-04: Offer price markup that AI agents can quote accurately
   - SVC-05: Crawlable pricing page in plain text

3. Trust & Credentials (15 pts):
   - TRS-01: Review schema with source attribution
   - TRS-03: Practitioner credentials in machine-readable text (Person schema)
   - TRS-04: Medical director licensure text

4. Machine-Readable Content (15 pts):
   - MRC-01: FAQPage schema for common treatment queries
   - MRC-02: Plain text policy pages (cancellation, intake, consent)
   - MRC-03: Structured Q&A formatting for AI retrieval

5. Actions & Booking (15 pts):
   - ACT-01: Crawlable booking URL (no JS-only blocker)
   - ACT-02: ReserveAction schema markup
   - ACT-03: Action payload schema for agent handoff

6. Crawl Policy & AI Permissions (10 pts):
   - CRL-01: llms.txt present and valid
   - CRL-02: AI bot allow rules in robots.txt (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot)
   - CRL-03: Clean sitemap index

7. Security Classification (10 pts):
   - SEC-01: 3-tier resource classification (Public Facts = Free, Booking = Controlled, Customer Data = Private)
   - SEC-02: API rate limits on action endpoints
   - SEC-03: No customer PII leakage

8. Freshness Signals (5 pts):
   - FRS-01: Page lastmod HTTP headers
   - FRS-02: Price update date markup
   - FRS-03: Freshness meta tags

## API Endpoints

### POST /api/scan
- Content-Type: application/json
- Payload: { "domain": "yourmedspa.com" }
- Response: { "score": number, "gaps": Array<{ code: string, category: string, text: string }> }
